title: Jesus... Why Do I Hate Every Photo Of Myself?
topic: hating how she looks in every photo of herself

bible.text: For the Lord takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with victory.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why do I hate every photo of myself? My friend posted one tonight and I made her delete it. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone else looked fine. I just kept zooming in on my face.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You looked at that photo the way you'd never look at a friend. You went searching for something wrong.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Because something is wrong. I'm not pretty like them.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You've compared yourself to filters and angles for so long that your real face started to feel like a mistake. It isn't.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Easy for You to say. You don't have to see me in the mirror.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I see you every day. And I'm not disappointed. I delight in you, the same face you keep trying to hide.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Before the mirror tomorrow, remember who's already smiling at you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What would you tell a friend who hated her own photos? 🙏
